article.headline: Ndalama scores 17 in Florida A&M's 66-58 victory against Alcorn State
article.description: — Miles Ndalama scored 17 points as Florida A&M beat Alcorn State 66-58 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Ndalama scores 17 in Florida A&M's 66-58 victory against Alcorn State

categories.description: Alcorn State Braves @ Florida A&M Rattlers

event.description: Alcorn State Braves @ Florida A&M Rattlers

keywords: Alcorn State Braves @ Florida A&M Rattlers
article.story: TALLAHASSEE, Fla. -- — Miles Ndalama scored 17 points as Florida A&M beat Alcorn State 66-58 on Saturday. Ndalama had three steals and three blocks for the Rattlers (8-9, 5-1 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Jaquan Sanders scored 13 points and added five rebounds and seven assists. Antonio Baker shot 5 of 8 from the field to finish with 11 points. Tycen McDaniels finished with 20 points, nine rebounds and four steals for the Braves (3-15, 2-4). Alcorn State also got 14 points and five steals from Jameel Morris. Davian Williams also put up 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
